method.title: Product next-step method with an ODE operational supplement

sources.relationship: Optional external professional method; linked only. This independently authored ODE supplement is not an endorsed or complete implementation of NMT.

logic.candidateGeneration: Generate alternatives including evidence gathering, bounded experiments, human decisions and stopping.
selectionPrinciples: Prefer useful information where a decision is blocked by missing evidence
Compare expected contribution and resource cost; retain rejected alternatives
logic.forecastApproach: State whether the outcome is feasible and what could change that view. No numerical probability without an estimation method and calibration evidence.
resourceRules: Sum costs of compatible experiments within the step budget
authorityRules: Customer contact and product changes require the product owner
reviewRules: Compare the preserved forecast with observations
Update the method only through a reviewed version

decisionClasses: Choose a bounded discovery or activation experiment
entryConditions: A proposed outcome with an accountable product owner
applicability.horizon: One bounded step, reviewed before committing the next
applicability.fallback: Describe the gap; request domain advice or a human decision. Do not execute an out-of-scope recommendation.

outcome.measure: Seven-day team activation without increasing support hours per activated team
outcome.baseline: Illustrative 40%; cohort coverage is an explicit open item
outcome.changeAuthority: Product owner; forecast updates do not amend the agreement

unknowns: Confirm the baseline and cohort before any offer
Method has no independent domain review or runtime trial

humanRequest.question: May we invite customers to a bounded study of the onboarding barrier?
options: Authorize the study within 3 hours and 50 USD
humanRequest.recommendation: Authorize only the scoped study; do not promise growth yet
humanRequest.consequences: Customer attention and staff time are used; the study may disconfirm the hypothesis
humanRequest.whileWaiting: Prepare an internal draft only; do not contact customers. Silence is not approval.
